answer: The gate is a collateralized invite graph. Each member mints two one-time invite certificates per epoch, each funded by a 250 POA escrow locked 180 days. A new identity redeems a certificate; the chain records the parent-child edge. If a reviewer flags a cluster as one operator, every escrow on that branch is slashed. Forging 500 clones costs 125,000 POA frozen half a year, all lost once shared behavior is detected. Picture a voyage along a ridge over open meadow: every step prepaid in escrowed cash, and one planted print collapses the trail behind you.
